Subject: Post-call recap — retention & DDQ items (Oakridge)

Thanks again for taking the time today — quick recap and clear next steps to keep momentum on the security/retention conversation. Notes below are high-level; please flag anything I missed.

Call highlights / Oakridge goals
- You need guaranteed audit-log retention for 18 months for production request/response traces (per internal policy).
- SOC 2 evidence required for procurement review (controls & recent report).
- Pen test summary and remediation timeline to satisfy third-party risk assessment.
- DPA addendum language around data residency and subprocessor list.

Action items (owners & eta)
1) Redwood: share SOC 2 controls mapping + current report copy — owner: Irene Choi — ETA: 2028-03-03.
2) Redwood: provide a short audit-log retention summary (what we store, retention windows, export options) — owner: Tessa Morgan — ETA: 2028-03-02.
3) Redwood: attach a one-page pen-test exec summary and indicate remediation cadence — owner: Security Eng — ETA: 2028-03-04.
4) Oakridge: confirm any special retention/legal hold requirements beyond 18 months, and preferred DPA edits — owner: Emma Li — ETA: 2028-03-06.

Attachments I'll upload here: redwood-soc2-controls-matrix.xlsx (draft), audit-log-retention-summary.pdf, pen-test-exec-summary-2027.pdf — please confirm receipt.

Next meeting: propose 2028-03-07 11:00am PT to review docs and align on procurement steps.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova

Subject: Re: Post-call recap — retention & DDQ items (Oakridge)

Sofia — thanks for the clear notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: 18 months is the baseline; we may need a separate export/archival path for regulatory holds (we'll flag if that arises). For now please confirm whether logs can be exported in bulk (S3-compatible) and whether exports include full request/response payloads or only metadata.

2) SOC 2: procurement asks for both the latest report (if available) and a mapped controls matrix. Redline requests to DPA will come from legal — I'll loop them in once we see the matrix.

3) Pen test: a one-page exec summary is perfect. We will escalate to our third-party risk board if remediation timelines are >60 days. Can Redwood indicate the severity buckets you use (critical/high/medium/low) in the summary?

We received the attachment stubs — please send the actual files or a secure link.

Best,
Emma Li
Senior InfoSec Analyst | Oakridge Bank
emma.li@oakridgebank.com

Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap — retention & DDQ items (internal)

Sofia — forwarding internal note. Short answers for the external Qs so we stay aligned before I send the controls matrix and report: 

- SOC 2: we can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a mapped controls matrix. I'll attach the matrix and a redacted report (PNI removed) by EOD 2028-03-03.
- Audit logs: production request/response traces are kept for 18 months; exports are available as compressed JSONL with full payloads for customers who have contractual DPIA/DPA permissions. Exports can be staged to an S3 bucket or shared via secure transfer.
- Pen test: summary has severity buckets (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and remediation windows; security engs confirm typical remediation target of 30-90 days depending on severity. I will ask security to produce the one-pager and include the severity legend.

Tessa — can you confirm the retention export process and an example file layout? I'll include that note in my external message.

Irene
Director, Compliance & Security Programs | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap — retention & DDQ items (Oakridge)

Emma — quick technical confirmation on exports and a short sample schema below. We'll include this in the PDF I attach.

- Export types: full_payloads (JSONL), metadata_only (CSV), and audit_events (JSON)
- Delivery: S3 (customers provide pre-signed bucket), or secure scp transfer by request
- Sample JSONL fields: timestamp, request_id, model_version, user_id_hash, request_payload, response_payload, latency_ms, route

We'll attach a redacted sample JSONL (single-line) and the audit-log-retention-summary.pdf in my next note (you should see the Drive link in the thread).

Timeline recap for Oakridge:
- 2028-03-03: SOC 2 controls matrix + redacted report (Irene)
- 2028-03-03: audit-log-retention-summary.pdf + sample JSONL (Tessa)
- 2028-03-04: pen-test-exec-summary-2027.pdf (Security)
